in_marathi.name: Chavan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chavan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chavan is derived from the Marathi language. It is a masculine name and is often given to boys. In Hindu mythology, Chavan refers to a young warrior. The name is believed to bring courage and strength to the one who bears it.
